_comment: Datadog webhook delivery as produced by the payload template in SPEC 11.3. Modelled on a real production monitor: a metric alert on feature-store online table lag, whose name follows the 'Feature Store — <what>' convention and whose message uses Datadog's {{#is_alert}} mustache section. Datadog substitutes $VARIABLES before POSTing, so these are resolved values, not templates.
title: [Triggered on {table:merchant_features}] Feature Store — online table lag >30h
body:
Feature store online table `merchant_features` has not been updated in >30h. Decisioning may be serving stale features.

metric: feature_store.online_table.hours_since_update
value: 34.2
threshold: 30.0
